course.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
course.instructor: Fei-Fei Li, Ehsan Adeli, with Zane Durante and guest lecturers

figureAudit.note: Counts are for the decks of the covered lecture (lecture 1 has two). Eight figure-, chart- and table-heavy slides per deck were checked at 600 dpi by an independent reader: part 2 came back clean; part 1 had errors on two slides (62, 64), corrected.

images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; each slide file's header lists its rendered slides; no index file
images.note: Lecture 1 only: 47 of part 1's 69 pages and 17 of part 2's 50. Not rendered: title, agenda and divider slides, text-only and logistics slides, build steps and recaps that repeat a rendered figure, and photographs of course staff and award winners.

caveats: Covers lecture 1 of 18 only; nothing on lectures 2-18.
Lecture 1 has two slide decks, each numbered from 1; cite as 'part 1, slide N' / 'part 2, slide N'. Part 2's printed numbers skip 4, 5 and 45, so they run ahead of the PDF page numbers.
Lecture 1's logistics slides (part 2, slides 33-48 and 50) were not presented in the recording; wiki/course-logistics.md is sourced to the slides as posted on April 1, 2025.
Verbatim auto-captions are not published; the transcripts are copy-edits with every restoration listed in their headers and seven passages marked unclear.
